QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_63

question.text: The settlement of GST in commodity delivery happens at:

answer.text: The full tax-paid invoice value as part of DVP settlement
A flat rate applied to all commodities
Zero rate — commodity delivery is GST-exempt
Separately from the exchange settlement process

explanation.text: The Logic: Delivery versus Payment (DVP) settlement is made for the full tax-paid invoice value. The seller raises a GST-inclusive bill at the final settlement price, and the exchange guarantees settlement of GST at the seller-provided rate at delivery billing. The Trap: GST rates vary by commodity, so a flat rate does not apply. Commodity delivery is not GST-exempt, and GST is not settled separately from the exchange settlement process — it is integrated into DVP.
